After existing type/length/nonblank checks, reject tokenize(input.query).length === 0 using the ranker's existing error: query must include at least one letter or number.

sourceChange.errorPrecedence: For a nonblank zero-token query, the existing lexical error is intended to occur before session/permission/path/scan errors and before later search-filter validation. Whitespace-only/type/oversized errors keep their earlier checks. This precedence is a source change, not verified behavior.
